newsitem.title: UK: J.D. Wetherspoon shares set new record.
newsitem.headline: J.D. Wetherspoon shares set new record.

text.p: Shares in J.D. Wetherspoon Plc, already one of the strongest UK market performers of the year, reached a new record on Tuesday amid renewed buying interest in the pubs operator, traders said.

Traders said the company was seen as a potential bid target as the UK pub sector undergoes rapid change with the growth of "themed" pubs, and brewers and other pub and leisure companies seek to expand their presence at the retail end.
But traders were unaware of any new factor boosting the stock today. "There is just the same old speculation hanging around," said one market maker.
Wetherspoon shares were up 62-1/2p at 11.12-1/2p by 0946 GMT, surpassing the previous peak of 10.60 stg set June 24. The shares have almost doubled in price since ending 1995 at 642p.
Trading volume in the stock was a meagre 37,500 shares.

A spokesman for Wetherspoon said he had no comment on the share price increase. Last month's bid for Tom Cobleigh Plc by Rank Organisation Plc has helped stoke the outbreak of bid speculation around Wetherspoon, traders said.
